card.name: Metric value after imperial measurement
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point, comma or parenthesis just before a metric number (cm, °C, litres, kilometers) that gives the converted value of an imperial or Fahrenheit figure. It also fires inside decimal metric numbers.

modes.label: Temperature conversion
modes.description: Space or bracket before a Celsius value paired with a Fahrenheit value in cooking or storage text.

modes.label: Inside converted decimals
modes.description: Decimal point or comma within a metric number that follows an inch or other imperial measure.

modes.label: Dimension lists
modes.description: Space before a size given in cm, as in catalog or object descriptions.

card.writes: It promotes length and weight unit words like meter, meters and kilograms, pushing the model to continue with a metric unit.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a metric number is about to be written, usually as a conversion from inches or Fahrenheit.
